name: Dip-buy
rule: Index (SPY, QQQ, IWM, SOXX) closes above its 200-day SMA with RSI(2) < 10: buy its 3x ETF (UPRO, TQQQ, TNA, SOXL) at the close, about $750 per sleeve. Exit at the first close above the index's 5-day SMA, or after 10 trading days. No stop. Signals checked about 3:50 PM ET with trading/research/signals.js. See trading/research/README.md.
